html:
Question 13
?

Given that the tangent line approximation to the function f(x) at x=2 overestimates the values of the function in the neighborhood of x=2, which of the following must be true?

a
f(x) has a global minimum at x=2
b
f(x) has a local minimum at x=2
c
f(x) is concave down in the neighborhood of x=2
d
f(x) is concave up in the neighborhood of x=2
e
f(x) is a linear function
